title: CLEAR-EO Webinar on climate & agriculture
summary: The webinar brings together experts from Earth observation, smart farming, policy, and global monitoring.
body:
## Combining ground sensors and satellite data: An integrated approach to climate-resilient agriculture

Climate extremes are already reshaping farming across Europe, increasing uncertainty and the need for timely, field-level information.

This CLEAR-EO webinar explores how combining IoT ground sensors with satellite Earth observation and meteorological data can deliver actionable intelligence for climate-resilient agriculture. Grounded in real-world experience from Thessaly, Greece, including the impacts of Storm Daniel, the session will showcase how NEUROPUBLIC’s gaiasense network is integrated with data from the Copernicus Programme, EUMETSAT, and ECMWF.

The webinar will also connect these innovations to broader European perspectives, with contributions from organisations such as the European Commission Joint Research Centre and COPA-COGECA . GEOGLAM provides global perspectives.

Join us to discover how integrating ground and satellite data is transforming agricultural decision-making, from reactive responses to proactive resilience.

### Program

The webinar brings together experts from Earth observation, smart farming, policy, and global monitoring. It is covering the full spectrum from field-level farmer experiences and IoT-enabled services to satellite-based early warning systems and European and global agricultural resilience frameworks. Here’s the programme:

- Welcome and introduction **Bente Lilja Bye**, BLB
- What keeps the farmers up at night? **Thomas Papakosmas**, Neuropublic
- Use of digital tools – farmers and agronomists experiences. **Foteini Lavdi**, Agricultural Cooperative of Farsala “FarsalonGi”
- CLEAR-EO Agriservice concept, **Thomas Papakosmas**, Neuropublic
- ASAP – Anomaly Hotspots of Agricultural Production, **Hervé Kerdilès**, JRC
- Climate Resilience and digitalization: Threats and opportunities for European farmers and agri-cooperatives, **Patrick Pagani**, COPA-COGECA
- GEOGLAM, crop monitoring and in-situ data, **Sven Gilliams**, GEOGLAM
- Discussion

The webinar is on **Thursday 30th April 2026, 15:00 CEST**

[Register for the webinar](https://blb.as/clear-eo-webinar-agri-1)
